يتراشقون (form VI)
# يَتَرَاشَقُونَ (yatarāšaqūna) /ja.ta.raː.ʃa.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
# يُتَرَاشَقُونَ (yutarāšaqūna) /ju.ta.raː.ʃa.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
